text:
Sam: quick flag from staging: we saw duplicate token attributions when an event landed ~3m after compaction.
Rina: ah the late-arrival tail. Minimal repro: `{"tenant":"t-7","req":"r-7","tokens":10,"fp":"fp7","ts":1692000000}` dedupe by fp+req upstream.
Vik: two paths: widen slop or add a repair flow. I want a third: compact emits a tiny proof/receipt index for dedupe keys, finalizer checks receipt before accepting post-compact events.
Sam: receipts sound promisingwhat would they contain?
Vik: sketch: `receipt = {window, fp, compact_seq, proof_ref}` (published to `metering.receipts`). Finalizer: on event referencing compacted window -> check receipts; if present accept, else emit `repair_voucher` to audit.
Rina: voucher would be: `{"type":"repair_voucher","tenant":"t-7","window":"2026-03-22T11:00Z","fps":["fp7"],"proofs":"s3://..."}` worker resolves and calls finalizer.apply_repair.
Sam: benefits: no heavy scans, auditable trail, TTLs bound repairs. Tradeoffs: another small stream and receipts write atomicity.
Vik: add LRU of recent fps (24h) in finalizer DB to speed lookups. If voucher worker cannot find raw events, mark `requires_review` and surface a ticket.
Rina: action items: (1) Vik prototype receipts+index; (2) Sam draft voucher schema + finalizer CAS contract; (3) ops to add `repair_voucher` metrics and alerts.
dept-bot: branch `proof-receipts-proto` created and CI started :white_check_mark:
